title: Sheinbaum Hands Ex-Durazo Estate to Education Project, Warns of Hurricane Trudy
detail: At her Oct 16 conference the SMN said Hurricane Trudy is Category 3 and strengthening, expected near Colima and Jalisco early Sunday. INDEP is transferring the 6-hectare Casa Tlalpan, once held by Arturo Durazo, for a Rosario Castellanos university campus (4,800 places from March 2027) and a technical high school for 1,200 students; investment about 150 million pesos. Bienestar will assist Ensenada and San Quintín after Rachel damaged at least 1,500 homes. Sheinbaum said she will attend APEC in China for two days, and that a Sonora gas liquefaction plant is suspended by an amparo.
